sloka: राजसंश्रयवश्यानां कुर्वन्तीनां पराज्ञया ।विधेयानां च दासीनां कः कुप्येद्वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.३९ ।।
transliteration: rājasaṁśrayavaśyānāṁ kurvantīnāṁ parājñayā ।vidheyānāṁ ca dāsīnāṁ kaḥ kupyedvānarottama ।। 6.116.39 ।।

translations.english: "O Illustrious lady! I would like to kill the terrible forms of ogres who threatened you, in that way, I will be at and strike in many ways and destroy them", said Hanuman to Sita.
